Frequently asked questions

Do I need a car?

Not to enjoy Yalos, the port and Chora, which you can reach on foot or by bus. A car is useful for the wild beaches in the south and east. The house has a private parking space.

How do I get to the house from the port?

The house is about 15 minutes' walk from the port, or 5 minutes by taxi. We send you the exact directions with your confirmation.

Is linen provided?

Yes, bed linen and bath towels are provided. [Beach towels: yes or no?]

Can we come with a baby?

Of course. [Cot and high chair available on request?] Please take care with the stairs and raised terraces with young children.

Is the house cleaned during the stay?

Cleaning during your stay is available on request. [Price]

Can I work remotely?

The house has Wi-Fi and a workspace. The connection is fine for email and simple video calls.

Are pets allowed?

No, pets are not allowed.

When is the best time to come?

June and September for warm sea and quiet days. July and August for the buzz of a Greek summer. April, May and October for walking and gentler prices.
